root_cause.text: The cfg80211 wireless configuration layer lacked validation to ensure that HE (802.11ax) and EHT (802.11be) capability structures are paired with their corresponding operational structures, allowing mac80211 to crash when eht_cap is set without eht_oper.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit consistency checks in `nl80211_calculate_ap_params()` that enforce `!!params->he_cap == !!params->he_oper` and `!!params->eht_cap == !!params->eht_oper`. The CVE description states "mac80211 could crash if eht_cap is set but eht_oper isn't," indicating that downstream code in mac80211 assumed these paired structures would always be present together, but the validation layer was not enforcing this invariant before passing parameters to mac80211.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add validation guards to ensure HE and EHT capability-operation parameter pairs are consistently present or absent in AP configuration.
intent_record.what: Added two validation checks in nl80211_calculate_ap_params() that ensure HE (High Efficiency) and EHT (Extremely High Throughput) capability and operation parameters are either both present or both absent, returning -EINVAL if they mismatch.
intent_record.how: These guards prevent inconsistent AP configuration states where HE/EHT capabilities are specified without corresponding operation parameters (or vice versa). At runtime, any attempt to configure an AP with mismatched HE or EHT parameters will now fail early with an error code, preventing potentially undefined behavior or misconfiguration downstream.
